scope: Executed actual source modules; targeted programmer regressions, not full UI/platform qualification.

checks.name: Merge requires matching resource, scope, chronological time and continuous state
Failed redo preserves cursor and can be retried
Open nested groups cannot move parent history; cancellation preserves parent group
A new committed edit invalidates redo
Failed grouped undo compensates completed steps and preserves the cursor
Failed group cancellation retains the group for recovery
Document commands retain their original baseline across a merge and expose bounded metadata
Composite commands execute forward, undo backward and report combined ownership
Bounded history metadata tracks undo, redo and clear without leaking mutable entries
Memory budget evicts oldest commands while retaining one oversized recoverable edit
Merged edits enforce the history memory budget as their document grows
